# Managedfile

Files osapi writes on a host and keeps a record of.

## Where it is served

Nowhere: it is internal. Other behaviors require it and call its methods
on the same host, so it has no route, no command and no permissions.

## Built on

| Uses | Used by |
| ---- | ------- |
| Nothing | [sysctl](../sysctl/sysctl.md) |

## Where it runs

On `debian`. On any other platform its methods report `skipped`.

It runs `chown` with sudo, so the agent's user needs a sudoers entry for it
unless the agent runs as root. `osapi agent start` checks this at startup.

It runs `stat`, which the host must have installed. `osapi agent start`
warns about any that are missing.

## Methods

| Method | Verb | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ----------- |
| `get` | read | Read the record of a file osapi wrote |
| `update` | write | Write a file and keep a record of it |
| `delete` | write | Remove a file osapi wrote and stop managing it |

## Settings

None. A behavior declares settings with `behavior.Config`.

## Inspecting it

```bash
osapi behavior get --name managedfile            # surfaces, methods, types, settings, telemetry
osapi behavior get --name managedfile --json     # the same, with each method's JSON Schema
```
